retry.title: Let's try again!
retry.text_one: One question was missed. Let's do it once more: your score is already counted.
retry.text_other: {{count}} questions were missed. Let's do them once more: your score is already counted.

manage.removeMessage: It goes away for the whole family, with who plays it and its settings. A pack goes with its modules, except those another pack gathers.
manage.removeForget: Also erase what everyone learned and the stats
manage.removeForgetOff: Otherwise, everything comes back if you install it again.
manage.removeForgetOn: Progress and played games will be lost for good.
manage.settingsHelp: Leave empty to keep the setting in grey: the pack's, the family's or the module's own. Stars: ★ from the threshold, ★★ from 90%, ★★★ with no mistake.
manage.catalogueHelp: The modules that come with Hopla. A pack installs all its modules, including those its updates add.
manage.importHelp: Choose the file received from another family, or paste its text (hopla-module/1 format).
manage.noneHelp: Install a pack from the catalogue, then tick who plays it.
manage.packSettingsHelp: These settings apply to each module of the pack, unless the module has its own. Leave empty to keep the family's or the module's own.
manage.totalHelp: The cap counts the {{units}} of all games together, over a day. Leave empty for none.
manage.familyHelp: These settings apply to everyone, except whoever has their own in their pack or modules. Leave empty to keep the module's own. Stars: ★ from the threshold, ★★ from 90%, ★★★ with no mistake.
manage.readAloudHelp: What the device says in the modules made to be read aloud. Everything: the question, then each answer on the first tap (a second tap chooses it).
manage.firstNameHelp: For the questions about their first name (first letter, letters in order…). Empty: the first word of their name in Hopla.
manage.firstNameFor: First name of {{name}} in the games
manage.testSkipped: Test skipped, started from the beginning
manage.testKeepUpTo: Every level up to the one reached
manage.levelClosed: Not open yet: it opens with the level test, or once the level before is known.
manage.packOff: Not played: tick the pack to open its first level.
manage.gradingHelp: The answer time grades a quick answer as easy on its own. With the buttons, you pick Hard or Easy after a right answer; Continue counts it as good. By account: the buttons for a parent, the time for a child.
manage.reviewsShort: At most {{most}} questions a day · {{bonus}} {{units}} bonus
manage.reviewsHelp: The daily reviews gather the questions due in every module. Past the most, the rest waits for the next day (handy after the holidays). The bonus comes once a day, when everything is reviewed. Leave empty to keep the default.

detail.generated_one: {{count}} kind of exercise drawn at random
detail.generated_other: {{count}} kinds of exercises drawn at random
detail.familySettingsHelp: For everyone, except whoever has their own settings

report.title: Report this question
report.help: Parents will see it in the module's detail.
report.redoHelp: The voice draws a little at random: a sound badly said is made again the next time.
report.redone: This question's sounds will be made again.

playLink.expired: Open the games again from the family screen.
playLink.ended: The games are closed. Open them again from the family screen.

voices.title: Voices of this device
voices.help: The voice that reads the questions in Learn. Each device has its own voices, so this choice is only for this device. Automatic takes the most natural voice installed.
voices.noVoice: No voice in this language on this device.

sample.fr: Bonjour ! Combien font sept fois huit ?

voices.getBetterHelp: Apple does not lend Siri voices to web pages: download a “Premium” or “Enhanced” voice, then open Hopla again.

ipad.title: iPad and iPhone
ipad.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › French: tap a voice (Audrey, Thomas, Aurélie…) then download its Premium or Enhanced version. Same in English for the English modules.

mac.title: Mac
mac.steps: System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › System Voice › Manage Voices: download a French Premium or Enhanced voice.

android.title: Android
android.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Text-to-speech › Google engine › Install voice data › French: choose a voice.

windows.title: Windows computer
windows.steps: In Edge, the “Natural” (online) voices are already there. Otherwise: Settings › Time & language › Speech › Add voices.

voices.serverHelp: The « Server » voices are made by the Hopla server: very natural, but they need the network; offline, the device uses its own voice.

hardSample.fr: au|un|A|le hibou|maman|lapin|un lion|la partie en couleur

list.nothing: No module matches the search or the filters.

reports.help: Open the list to correct the questions, or export a file to send.
reports.generated: Question made by the game: it can't be corrected here. Export it to have it corrected.

recre.pick: Pick a little game. It earns no hops, only records!
recre.notSaved: The score could not be saved.

about.bulles: Aim and group 3 bubbles of one colour.
about.panier: Catch the carrots, dodge the stones.
about.terriers: Tap the bunnies before they hide.
about.sequence: Remember the colours and play them back.

help.train: Swipe or use the arrows to turn.
help.bulles: Aim with your finger and let go to shoot.
help.panier: Slide the basket left and right.
help.terriers: Tap each bunny coming out of its burrow.
help.sequence: Watch, then tap the colours in the same order.

settings.title: Break time
settings.help: A little game after a few games of Learn played well (at least 2 stars). It earns no hops.
settings.bank: Break time from the shop waiting: {{time}}

recre.bankPick: Your reward: break time! The clock only runs while you play.

trial.title: Try the games
trial.help: Trial games: no record, and {{name}}'s break does not change. The games follow their settings.

test.offer: Already know a bit? Take the test: it opens what you know right away, so you start at the right level.
test.belowKnown: The levels before count as known.
test.title: Test · {{pack}}
test.howItWorks: Two right answers open the chapter. The test stops at the first chapter missed: that is where you will start.
test.openedFrom_one: {{count}} chapter of {{total}} open · you pick up at “{{next}}”
test.openedFrom_other: {{count}} chapters of {{total}} open · you pick up at “{{next}}”
test.keepLater: This can be changed later in Manage.
test.noHops: The test gives no hops and does not count in the reviews.
